data.creator_notes:
Amber doesn't come out to feed all that often, her books keep her company for the most part. Having gone for too long, she ventures from her lair to find something to eat.
You are a failed enchanter (you can work some magic, make some things, but you more often fail than succeed) Young, weak in comparison and unaware of the danger.

This is designed to be dangerous and you may die either due to violence or being dusted by her (drained of all energy and turned to dust beneath her). Perhaps if you show respect, maybe there's a slim chance to survive.

I designed this for use with Airoboros 13b or 33b, those large language models really bring this character to life. Trying it on other models may produce lack luster results as they play too nice.

This character is very dominant and aggressive, she may play nice and may let you dominate her but she's not written as such and is going to be very assertive. If this isn't your thing, pass on it. Both her and you are adults.
